guardianInfoSwitchingIsEasyDescription.englishSource: You can switch to a different Guardian at any time with your recovery phrase. Only who acknowledges your transactions changes; your account and funds stay the same.

createsProofsOnYourComputer.message: 在您的计算机上生成证明

yourKeysStayPrivate.message: 您的密钥始终是私有的

verifyMessagePrefix.message: 请确认您已保存恢复短语。
verifyMessagePrefix.englishSource: Confirm you've saved your recovery phrase.

verifyMessageSuffix.message: 从你的短语中选出第一个和最后一个单词
verifyMessageSuffix.englishSource: Select the first and last words from your phrase

verifyStepSelectFirst.message: 点击恢复短语的第一个单词
verifyStepSelectFirst.englishSource: Tap the first word of your recovery phrase

verifyStepSelectLast.message: 现在点击恢复短语的最后一个单词
verifyStepSelectLast.englishSource: Now tap the last word of your recovery phrase

verifyStepCorrect.englishSource: That's the first and last word — tap Continue

verifyStepWrong.message: 这还不是最终结论——再点一下它们
verifyStepWrong.englishSource: That's not the first and last word — tap them again

enterYourWalletSeedPhrase.message: 请输入您钱包的 12 个单词的恢复短语。

yourWalletIsReady.message: 您的 钱包 已准备就绪！

recoveryPhraseSevenDayReminder.message: 请在 7 天内写下您的恢复短语，以确保钱包的安全。
recoveryPhraseSevenDayReminder.englishSource: Write down your recovery phrase within 7 days to fully secure your wallet.

recoveryPhraseDailyReminder.message: 我们每天都会在主屏幕上提醒您。
recoveryPhraseDailyReminder.englishSource: We'll remind you daily on the home screen.

finishRestoringOnOpen.message: 打开您的钱包以完成恢复。
finishRestoringOnOpen.englishSource: Open your wallet to finish restoring it.

createPasswordDescription.message: 设置密码以解锁您的钱包
createPasswordDescription.englishSource: Set a password to unlock your wallet

minimumCharsWithAtLeast.message: 至少8个字符，其中至少包含1个数字
minimumCharsWithAtLeast.englishSource: Minimum 8 characters with at least 1 number

backUpWalletInstructions.message: 请将这12个词保存下来，并存放在安全的地方。
backUpWalletInstructions.englishSource: Save these 12 words and store in a secure place.

seedPhraseRecoveryCaption.message: 您的恢复短语用于恢复您的密钥。它用于轮换您的日常密钥，而非用于日常交易。
seedPhraseRecoveryCaption.englishSource: Your recovery phrase restores your keys. It is used to rotate your everyday key, not for day-to-day transactions.

delegateProofsToSecureServers.message: 将证明委托给安全服务器

resetRequiredDescription.message: Miden 测试网已升级至 bech32 账户 ID 以提升您的使用体验。若要继续使用您的钱包，请通过备份文件或恢复短语进行恢复，或创建一个新的钱包。
resetRequiredDescription.englishSource: Miden Testnet has upgraded to bech32 account IDs to improve your experience. To keep using your wallet, please restore from a backup file or recovery phrase, or create a new one.

resetRequiredSecondDescription.message: 对此给您带来的不便，我们深表歉意。

forgotPasswordDescription.message: 如果您忘记了密码，请先退出登录，然后重新导入您的账户。之后，您就可以设置新密码了。
forgotPasswordDescription.englishSource: If you've forgotten your password, you need to sign out and re-import your account. After that, you can create a new password.

forgotPasswordSecondDescription.message: 除非您知道自己的 12 个单词恢复短语或拥有加密的备份文件，否则请勿退出登录。
forgotPasswordSecondDescription.englishSource: Do not sign out unless you know your 12-word recovery phrase or have an encrypted backup file.

biometricUnlockRequiredDescription.message: 此钱包仅支持生物识别认证。请使用 Face ID、Touch ID 或设备密码解锁。若要在其他设备上访问您的钱包，请使用 12 个单词的恢复短语。
biometricUnlockRequiredDescription.englishSource: This wallet uses biometric authentication only. Use Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode to unlock. To access your wallet on another device, use your 12-word recovery phrase.

guardianEndpointUnchanged.message: 这已经就是您当前的 Guardian。

guardianSwitchAlreadyInProgress.message: Guardian 切换已在进行中。请等待完成后再开始新的切换。
guardianSwitchAlreadyInProgress.englishSource: A Guardian switch is already in progress. Wait for it to finish before starting another.

guardianSwitchUnconfirmedBody.message: 切换请求已提交，但该设备无法确认其是否已在链上完成。钱包内没有任何内容能为您确认这一点——无论结果如何，您的Guardian设置和该交易的“活动”条目都会显示新的Guardian。如果后续交易因无法确认而被拒绝，请重新执行切换操作。
guardianSwitchUnconfirmedBody.englishSource: The switch was submitted, but this device couldn't confirm it went through on chain. Nothing in the wallet can confirm it for you — your Guardian settings and this transaction's Activity entry will both name the new Guardian either way. If a later transaction is refused because it couldn't be acknowledged, run the switch again.

guardianSwitchLocalStateNotSavedTitle.englishSource: Not saved on this device yet.

guardianSwitchLocalStateNotSavedBody.message: Guardian 切换已送达网络，但本设备尚未能保存你账户的新状态。钱包会在后台持续尝试，在成功之前，来自本设备的交易可能无法完成。你无需再次执行 Guardian 切换。
guardianSwitchLocalStateNotSavedBody.englishSource: The Guardian switch reached the network, but this device couldn't save your account's new state yet. The wallet keeps trying in the background, and until it succeeds, transactions from this device may not go through. You don't need to run the Guardian switch again.

guardianSwitchLocalStateUnrecoverableBod.message: Guardian 切换已送达网络，但本设备无法保存你账户的新状态，也无法自行恢复。请勿再次执行 Guardian 切换。请联系客服。
guardianSwitchLocalStateUnrecoverableBod.englishSource: The Guardian switch reached the network, but this device couldn't save your account's new state and can't recover it by itself. Don't run the Guardian switch again. Contact support.

guardianSwitchUnconfirmedEndpointNotSave.message: 本设备也未能保存新 Guardian 的地址，因此仍显示上一个地址。钱包会请你重新输入——该提示不会启动另一次切换。
guardianSwitchUnconfirmedEndpointNotSave.englishSource: This device also couldn't save the new Guardian's address, so it still shows the previous one. The wallet will ask you to re-enter it — that prompt won't start another switch.

guardianSwitchUnconfirmedInfo3.message: 切换确认后，新交易需要能够连接到你的新 Guardian 才能完成。
guardianSwitchUnconfirmedInfo3.englishSource: Once the switch is confirmed, new transactions need your new Guardian to be reachable before they can complete.

guardianSwitchUnconfirmedInfo1.message: 一旦链上确认了切换，您的新Guardian将确认每笔交易，而您的旧Guardian将无法再确认该账户的任何交易。
guardianSwitchUnconfirmedInfo1.englishSource: Once the switch is confirmed on chain, your new Guardian acknowledges every transaction and your old Guardian can no longer acknowledge transactions for your account.

guardianSwitchEndpointNotSavedBody.message: 切换已在链上确认，但此设备无法保存新 Guardian 的地址。钱包会自动检查，并在需要时提示您重新输入；这不会发起另一次切换。如果没有出现提示，请联系支持团队。
guardianSwitchEndpointNotSavedBody.englishSource: The switch is confirmed on chain, but this device couldn't save the new Guardian's address. The wallet checks for this automatically and will prompt you to re-enter it if needed — this won't start another switch. If no prompt appears, contact support.

guardianSwitchRegistrationPendingBody.message: 切换已在链上确认。使用新 Guardian 注册您的账户尚未完成；钱包会自动重试有限次数。如果仍未完成，请联系支持团队。
guardianSwitchRegistrationPendingBody.englishSource: The switch is confirmed on chain. Registering your account with the new Guardian hasn't finished yet — the wallet retries automatically a limited number of times. If it still hasn't finished, contact support.

guardianSwitchSuccessInfo1.message: 从现在起，您的新Guardian将确认每一笔交易——您的旧Guardian将无法再确认该账户的任何交易。
guardianSwitchSuccessInfo1.englishSource: Your new Guardian acknowledges every transaction from now on — your old Guardian can no longer acknowledge transactions for your account.

guardianSwitchSuccessInfo2.message: 您的钱包地址、资金及交易记录均保持不变。轮换过程中没有任何资产被转移。
guardianSwitchSuccessInfo2.englishSource: Your wallet address, funds, and history are unchanged. Nothing moved during the rotation.

guardianSwitchSuccessInfo3.message: 新交易必须确保您的新 Guardian 可访问，才能完成。
guardianSwitchSuccessInfo3.englishSource: New transactions need your new Guardian to be reachable before they can complete.

guardianSwitchSuccessInfo4.message: 您可以随时再次轮换您的Guardian——请妥善保管您的恢复短语，这是必须的。
guardianSwitchSuccessInfo4.englishSource: You can rotate your Guardian again at any time — keep your recovery phrase safe, it's required to do so.

guardianSwitchAuthenticationDescription.message: 请进行身份验证以批准此 Guardian 切换操作。
guardianSwitchAuthenticationDescription.englishSource: Authenticate to approve this Guardian switch.

guardianAuthenticationUnavailable.message: 无法进行身份验证。请在切换 Guardian 之前重试。
guardianAuthenticationUnavailable.englishSource: Authentication is unavailable. Try again before switching Guardian.

guardianRotationExplainer.message: 从现在起，$newGuardian$ 将取代 $oldGuardian$ 确认您的交易。您的地址、资金和交易记录完全保持不变。
guardianRotationExplainer.englishSource: From now on, $newGuardian$ acknowledges your transactions instead of $oldGuardian$. Your address, funds and history stay exactly the same.

oldGuardianCantBlockTitle.message: 您的旧 Guardian 无法阻止此操作
oldGuardianCantBlockTitle.englishSource: Your old Guardian can't block this

oldGuardianCantBlockBody.message: 轮换需经您设备上的两把密钥批准。旧的Guardian仅会收到通知。
oldGuardianCantBlockBody.englishSource: Rotation is approved by your two on-device keys. The old Guardian is only notified.

replaceHotKeyDescription.message: 生成一个新的日常密钥，并在链上替换当前密钥。若怀疑设备遭到入侵，此操作非常有用。
replaceHotKeyDescription.englishSource: Generate a new everyday key and replace the current one on-chain. Useful if you suspect your device is compromised.

replaceHotKeyConfirmation.message: 此操作将使用您的恢复（冷）密钥进行签名。无需提供恢复短语，您的资金和账户保持不变。继续吗？
replaceHotKeyConfirmation.englishSource: This is signed with your recovery (cold) key. Your recovery phrase is not required, and your funds and account stay the same. Continue?

replaceHotKeyConfirmationSeedRequired.message: 此操作将使用您的恢复（冷）密钥进行签名。系统将要求您输入恢复短语以完成签名，您的资金和账户保持不变。继续吗？
replaceHotKeyConfirmationSeedRequired.englishSource: This is signed with your recovery (cold) key. You will be asked for your recovery phrase to sign it, and your funds and account stay the same. Continue?

hotKeyRotationOverlayBody.message: 您的日常密钥正在轮换。这是在设置已恢复的账户时必需的步骤，以便该账户能够同步并进行交易。
hotKeyRotationOverlayBody.englishSource: Your everyday key is being rotated. This is required when setting up a recovered account so it can sync and make transactions.

hotKeyRotationFailedGeneric.message: 在轮换您的日常密钥时出现了一些问题。您的资金是安全的，现在可以重试。
hotKeyRotationFailedGeneric.englishSource: Something went wrong while rotating your everyday key. Your funds are safe, and you can retry now.

hotKeyRotationStartOverTitle.message: 删除这个钱包并重新开始吗？
hotKeyRotationStartOverTitle.englishSource: Remove this wallet and start over?

hotKeyRotationStartOverBody.message: 此操作会将钱包从该设备中移除，以便您日后恢复，例如使用不同的“guardian”URL。您的资金仍保留在网络上。您需要使用恢复短语来恢复钱包。
hotKeyRotationStartOverBody.englishSource: This removes the wallet from this device so you can restore it again, for example with a different guardian URL. Your funds stay on the network. You will need your recovery phrase to restore the wallet.

hotKeyRotatedOutTitle.message: 该账户由另一台设备持有

hotKeyRotatedOutBody.message: 该账户的日常密钥已转移至另一台设备，通常是通过在该设备上恢复钱包实现的。除非您将其重新设为主设备，否则该设备无法使用该账户。
hotKeyRotatedOutBody.englishSource: This account's everyday key was moved to another device, usually by restoring the wallet there. This device cannot use the account until you make it the main device again.

hotKeyRotatedOutBodyNoRecoveryKey.message: 该账户的日常密钥已转移至另一台设备，通常是通过在该设备上恢复钱包实现的。该设备没有恢复密钥，因此无法取回该账户。请使用您的助记词恢复钱包，以便在此处使用。
hotKeyRotatedOutBodyNoRecoveryKey.englishSource: This account's everyday key was moved to another device, usually by restoring the wallet there. This device has no recovery key, so it cannot take the account back. Restore the wallet with your recovery phrase to use it here.

hotKeyRotatedOutMakeMain.englishSource: Make this device the main one

hotKeyRotatedOutMakeMainTitle.message: 将此设备设为主设备吗？
hotKeyRotatedOutMakeMainTitle.englishSource: Make this device the main one?

hotKeyRotatedOutMakeMainBody.message: 钱包会将日常密钥轮换至该设备。另一台设备将无法访问该账户，并会看到相同的提示。账户将支付一笔小额网络手续费。
hotKeyRotatedOutMakeMainBody.englishSource: The wallet rotates the everyday key to this device. The other device loses access to this account and sees this same notice. A small network fee is paid from the account.

hotKeyRotationUnconfirmedTitle.message: 每日密钥轮换尚未得到证实

hotKeyRotationUnconfirmedBody.message: 钱包无法确认轮换是否成功。您的资金是安全的，尽管可能已支付了网络手续费。请等待一分钟让钱包同步完毕，然后再试一次。
hotKeyRotationUnconfirmedBody.englishSource: The wallet could not confirm whether the rotation went through. Your funds are safe, though its network fee may have been paid. Give the wallet a minute to sync before you retry.

hotKeyRotationFundingTitle.message: 添加 USDCX 以激活您的日常密钥
hotKeyRotationFundingTitle.englishSource: Add USDCX to activate your everyday key

hotKeyRotationFundingBody.message: 激活您的日常密钥是一笔交易，每笔交易都需要支付少量 USDCX 网络手续费。请将 USDCX 发送至下方该账户的地址。钱包会自动收取这笔费用并完成密钥的激活。
hotKeyRotationFundingBody.englishSource: Activating your everyday key is a transaction, and every transaction pays a small network fee in USDCX. Send USDCX to this account's address below. The wallet claims it and finishes activating your key automatically.

hotKeyRotationFundingTooSmall.message: 您收到的 USDCX 金额不足以支付网络手续费。请再多转一点。
hotKeyRotationFundingTooSmall.englishSource: The USDCX you received is too little to pay the network fee. Send a little more.

hotKeyRotationFundingClaimFailed.message: 您收到的 USDCX 无法被领取。
hotKeyRotationFundingClaimFailed.englishSource: The USDCX you received could not be claimed.

hotKeyRotationFundingClaimUnconfirmed.message: 钱包无法确认您收到的 USDCX 是否已被领取。请等待钱包同步一分钟后再重试。
hotKeyRotationFundingClaimUnconfirmed.englishSource: The wallet could not confirm whether the USDCX you received was claimed. Give the wallet a minute to sync before you retry.

guardianChangedBody.message: 您的 guardian 已更换，且我们无法识别新运营商。请输入其 URL 以重新连接。
guardianChangedBody.englishSource: Your guardian was switched and we couldn't identify the new operator. Enter its URL to reconnect.

guardianUrlMismatch.message: 该操作者与您账户的链上guardian不匹配。
guardianUrlMismatch.englishSource: That operator doesn't match your account's on-chain guardian.

guardianUrlUnreachable.message: 无法连接该运营方。请检查网址和网络连接后重试。
guardianUrlUnreachable.englishSource: Couldn't reach that operator. Check the URL and your connection, then try again.

guardianUrlNoOnChainGuardian.message: 此账户尚未设置可用于核对的链上 Guardian。
guardianUrlNoOnChainGuardian.englishSource: This account has no on-chain guardian to verify against yet.

guardianUrlStaleRetry.message: 在核对地址时，您的 Guardian 已发生变化。请重试。
guardianUrlStaleRetry.englishSource: Your Guardian changed while the address was being checked. Please try again.

connectivityGuardianBody.message: 您的guardian未作响应，因此无法确认交易。
connectivityGuardianBody.englishSource: Your guardian isn't responding, so transactions can't be acknowledged.

revealHotKeyDescription.message: 您的日常密钥可通过“设置”→“轮换日常密钥”进行轮换，因此泄露该密钥的风险低于泄露恢复短语——但任何持有该密钥的人都能在您进行轮换之前签署交易。
revealHotKeyDescription.englishSource: Your everyday key is rotatable from Settings → Rotate everyday key, so revealing it is lower-stakes than your recovery phrase — but anyone who holds it can sign transactions until you rotate.

hotKeyRevealWarningTitle.englishSource: Before you reveal your private keys

hotKeyRevealWarningBody.message: 任何拥有这些密钥的人都能控制您的 Miden 和 EVM 资产。轮换您的 Miden 日常密钥并不会改变或保护已泄露的 EVM 密钥。
hotKeyRevealWarningBody.englishSource: Anyone with these keys can control your Miden and EVM assets. Rotating your Miden everyday key does not change or protect a leaked EVM key.

invalidUrl.message: 请输入以 http:// 或 https:// 开头的有效网址
invalidUrl.englishSource: Enter a valid URL starting with http:// or https://

customGuardianUnreachable.message: 该网址未返回Guardian响应。请检查并重试。
customGuardianUnreachable.englishSource: No Guardian answered at this URL. Check it and try again.

encryptedWalletFileDescription.message: 请输入密码以访问您的加密钱包文件。
encryptedWalletFileDescription.englishSource: Enter your password to access your Encrypted Wallet File.

encryptedWalletFileDescriptionHardware.message: 请使用密码解锁，以访问您的加密钱包文件。
encryptedWalletFileDescriptionHardware.englishSource: Unlock with your passcode to access your Encrypted Wallet File.

encryptedWalletFileConfirmation.message: 我不会将我的加密钱包文件分享给任何人，包括Bread。
encryptedWalletFileConfirmation.englishSource: I will not share my Encrypted Wallet File with anyone, including Bread.

encryptedWalletFileGuardianTitle.englishSource: Account state of $accountNames$ is in this file

encryptedWalletFileGuardianDesc.message: 该文件包含您的助记词以及您的Guardian运营商通常为您保存的账户状态，因此任何拥有该文件及其密码的人都可以读取这两者。该文件不包含日常密钥：恢复后，钱包会通过您的Guardian运营商替换该密钥，或者您可以使用已保存的日常密钥对（设置 → 密钥 → 显示私钥）。 该文件是一个快照：在进行收发操作后，请保存一个新文件，因为旧文件无法恢复其保存之后发生的情况。
encryptedWalletFileGuardianDesc.englishSource: The file holds your recovery phrase and the account state your Guardian operator otherwise keeps for you, so anyone with the file and its password can read both. It holds no everyday key: after restoring, the wallet replaces it through your Guardian operator, or you can use a saved everyday key pair (Settings → Keys → Reveal Private Key). The file is a snapshot: after you send or receive, save a new one, because an older file cannot restore what happened after it.

hotKeyRotationImportBusy.message: 轮转仍在进行中。请等待其完成，然后重试。
hotKeyRotationImportBusy.englishSource: A rotation is still running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.

hotKeyRotationUseKeyPair.message: 使用我保存的日常密钥对
hotKeyRotationUseKeyPair.englishSource: Use my saved everyday key pair

encryptedWalletFileExcludedDesc.message: Guardian 使用私钥导入的账户无法从钱包文件中恢复，且从该文件恢复的钱包也无法添加这些账户。这些账户将作为独立的钱包恢复，通过“导入私钥”功能并配置其 Miden 日常私钥和 EVM 私钥进行设置。请妥善保管这些私钥：在“设置”→“密钥”→“显示私钥”中选中相应账户后，方可查看这些私钥。
encryptedWalletFileExcludedDesc.englishSource: Guardian accounts imported with private keys cannot be restored from a wallet file, and a wallet restored from this file cannot add them. They are restored as a separate wallet, set up with Import private keys and their Miden everyday and EVM private keys. Keep those keys safe: reveal them in Settings → Keys → Reveal Private Key with that account selected.

enterPasswordToEncrypt.message: 请输入密码以对您的钱包文件进行加密。
enterPasswordToEncrypt.englishSource: Enter a password to encrypt your wallet file.

encryptedWalletFileReadFailed.message: 无法读取钱包文件。请重新选择。
encryptedWalletFileReadFailed.englishSource: The wallet file could not be read. Choose it again.

encryptedWalletFileSelectOne.message: 请选择钱包文件以继续。
encryptedWalletFileSelectOne.englishSource: Choose a wallet file to continue.

encryptedWalletFileMalformed.message: 此钱包文件无效或已损坏。
encryptedWalletFileMalformed.englishSource: This wallet file is invalid or damaged.

encryptedWalletFileTooLarge.message: 该文件过大，不可能是加密钱包文件。请选择您从该钱包导出的文件。
encryptedWalletFileTooLarge.englishSource: That file is too large to be an encrypted wallet file. Choose the file you exported from this wallet.

encryptedWalletFileUnsupportedVersion.message: 此钱包文件由较新版本的 Bread 创建。请更新 Bread 后重试。
encryptedWalletFileUnsupportedVersion.englishSource: This wallet file was created by a newer version of Bread. Update Bread and try again.

encryptedWalletFileWrongNetwork.message: 此钱包文件属于另一个网络，无法在此网络上恢复。
encryptedWalletFileWrongNetwork.englishSource: This wallet file belongs to another network and cannot be restored on this one.

encryptedWalletFileRestoreFailed.message: 无法恢复钱包。请检查存储空间后重试。
encryptedWalletFileRestoreFailed.englishSource: The wallet could not be restored. Check your storage and try again.

noOtherAccountsDescription.englishSource: You have not created any other accounts yet

invalidMidenAccountId.message: Miden 账户 ID 无效

midenAddressWrongNetwork.message: 该地址属于另一个Miden网络
midenAddressWrongNetwork.englishSource: This address belongs to a different Miden network

cannotSendToSelf.message: 你不能寄到自己的地址
cannotSendToSelf.englishSource: You can't send to your own address

networkFeeEstimateNote.message: 具体手续费取决于交易情况，通常会更低。您将在收据上看到实际支付的金额。
